decisions.reason: The 15-day express delivery program remains aligned with core delivery services and is still mentioned on the website, indicating continued strategic fit.
The 72-hour express delivery program is operationally demanding and only mentioned rather than featured, creating a moderate chance of consolidation or discontinuation.
The express delivery program for doors and gates has a dedicated page and strong fit with the firm's core product line, making discontinuation very unlikely.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic digital extension with its own page, so it is likely to be retained despite moderate transformation risk.
The fire and smoke protection door addresses strong safety and compliance demand and gained a dedicated page in 2024, so the firm will almost certainly keep it.
